title: AnnanGol Korean BBQ
meta_desc: AnnanGol (아난골), Korean charcoal BBQ and home-style Korean food in Annandale, VA. LA galbi, pork galbi, jokbal, stews and hot pots. K-JjamBab tray breakfast every morning 7–10 AM.
og_desc: Korean BBQ, stews and chef specials. Plus K-JjamBab breakfast, 7–10 AM, $13.99, no tip.
lede: Marinated LA galbi, pork galbi, braised jokbal and bubbling hot pots, in Annandale, Virginia.
q_breakfast: Mornings 7–10 AM: K-JjamBab tray breakfast, $13.99, no tip

d_galbitang: Beef short rib soup with glass noodles.

d_yukgaejang: Spicy shredded beef and vegetable soup.

d_kongchi: Aged kimchi stew with saury and tofu.

am_p: Before lunch, AnnanGol serves K-JjamBab, a Korean military-style tray breakfast: rice with a fried egg, a warm soup, three side dishes and a main that changes every day. Roasted gim on the side.
in_title: Tables built for grilling, and room for the whole party.
v_title: Find the pink sign on Tom Davis Drive.
hours2: Full menu 10 AM–10 PM, 365 days a year
fine: For prices and today's menu, see our online order page. All BBQ pork and beef items may be served undercooked. Consuming raw or undercooked meat, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness.
